title: Inventory
subtitle: The workshop's parts stock, shared by the whole fleet.

form.minQuantityHint: Alert when the quantity reaches this threshold.

list.linkedParts: {count, plural, one {# linked engine part} other {# linked engine parts}}

empty.title: No item in stock
empty.description: Add the workshop's parts, or import the stock recorded on engines.

import.banner: {count, plural, one {# engine part tracks} other {# engine parts track}} a stock of its own. Import them into the inventory: one item per reference, its quantity being the sum of the engine stocks — check it with a count afterwards.
import.movementNote: Import of stock recorded per engine

show.deleteMessage: Its movement log will be erased and linked engine parts will go back to their own stock.
show.noLinkedParts: No engine part is linked to this item. Link one from an engine's Parts tab.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.empty: No supplier yet. Add one to place orders.
suppliers.deleteMessage: Items that had it as their usual supplier will no longer have one.
suppliers.leadTime: {days, plural, one {delivered in # day} other {delivered in # days}}

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.subtitle: Order from your suppliers; receiving an order updates the stock.
orders.prerequisites: Add at least one supplier and one item to place an order.

receiveConfirm.title: Receive this order?
receiveConfirm.message: Ordered quantities enter the stock and the items' average cost is recalculated.
receiveConfirm.messageBoat: Ordered quantities enter the stock, the average cost is recalculated and the amount is added to {boat}'s budget.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this purchase order?
deleteConfirm.message: The order and its lines will be erased.

reorder.hint: Prepares a draft with its items below threshold.

form.boatHint: Optional: receiving will charge the amount to its budget.
